title: Dense tables and mobile alternatives
description: Develop dense tables and mobile alternatives using Tailwind v4 principles, accessible React markup and a meaningful offline bug-hunt lab.
objectives: Explain the accessibility and design invariant behind dense tables and mobile alternatives
